posts.text: Bear Put spread , is it to better to book profit now — Your thesis has come true, but the trade hasn’t paid off as you expected. A bear put spread has some negative theta, so holding it longer would eat away at your premium. To profit more off this trade you need: either a continuation of the move downward hold it to expiry (dangerous as you could take max loss) and have the index stay well below the BEP. Give yourself more time to be right next time - choose monthly or next month expiry. Target 50% of the max profit. Close the trade at the midpoint of the contract duration.
